snippet.title: Sherwood - Commodore 64 - longplay & ALL endings
snippet.description:
From the same team behind MUSKETEER (https://youtu.be/8AlR0cCUdXE).
"Robin Hood just won the archery tournament at Nottingham Castle. But as the last of Robin’s three enchanted arrows struck the bullseye, the magic concealing his identity was lost. Robin now stands revealed before the triumphant gaze of Prince John and his Norman guards: A wolfshead with a price on his head, caught in a deadly trap!
Can Robin make safe his escape into Sherwood forest, help the people in need and thwart the scheming Prince John?
Good luck, ‘Robin of the Wood’!"
Full infos here: https://psytronik.itch.io/sherwood

Many many many thanks to minotaurus for this longplay!
He said "most difficul than Musketeer, with some hidden object to collect and a map hiding a secret (see intro screen ;)).
You can find how many gameplay elements are borrowed directly from Musketeer.
If you collect hidden coins you can buy a ring for Marion and you'll have hearts floating during the ending sequence. Otherwise, no ring no love 😜"
An extra thanks to minotaurus because he sent me this longplay as a gift for my son birth! big love 😍

This video is part of the videogame endings database, whose goal is to catalogue and create the world's largest archive of videogame endings! (what an humble and not ambitious project :D)

If you want to contribute please let me know!

#retrogaming
